about_the_game:
Awaken in a shattered world of dark wonders.

Venture into thrilling Roguelite RPG extraction adventure. After a mysterious awakening, you find yourself stranded on a floating island adrift in a haunting dark fantasy realm. Surrounded by eerie creatures and crumbling ruins, you must explore treacherous biomes—a whispering forest shrouded in secrets, a drowned city swallowed by the depths, and scorching deserts hiding forgotten legends.

Battle monstrous bosses, scavenge rare resources to fortify your sanctuary, and craft powerful gear to survive the perils of this fractured world.

Class System:

Warrior – Master brute force or become an unbreakable bastion. Skill trees let you rage-fueled berserkers or shield-bearing commanders.
Ranger – Stalk prey with poison-tipped arrows or dominate the battlefield with deployable traps.
Wizard – Wield raw elemental storms or delve into hexes that corrupt foes.

Each class evolves through sanctuary upgrades, blending traditional roles with dark-fantasy twists. Customize further via faction gear and hybrid perks. Become legend—or something entirely new.

Key Features:

  • Risk & Reward Raids: Venture into cursed zones. Survive escalating dangers to claim rare loot—or lose everything. Use spoils to expand your sanctuary’s defenses, workshops, or mystical archives, each path unlocking unique skills to forge your own hybrid class.

  • Sanctuary Evolution: Invest resources into three distinct upgrade trees (power, agility, knowledge) to reshape your abilities. Mix magic, brute force, and cunning to create a playstyle as unique as your character’s customizable appearance.

  • Unlock the Unknown: Defeat local Beasts to tear open portals to new realms. Each kill grants a Keystone Fragment—assemble them. Each victory reshapes the world, revealing hidden dungeons and forgotten lore.

  • Reputation Matters: Trade with wandering merchants, complete dangerous contracts, and earn their trust to access elite gear blueprints and forbidden artifacts.

  • No Cosmetic Fluff: Your appearance reflects your choices. Wear a smuggler’s scarred leathers, a scholar’s rune-stitched robes, or shining armor to serve your playstyle.

  • Cryptic Secrets: Decay is not random. Uncover environmental clues, scattered journals, and sacrificial altars to piece together the truth—or bury it forever.

The world is dying. Your sanctuary is the last spark. Will you reignite it—or loot its ashes?

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 660 or Intel® Arc™ A380 or AMD Radeon™ R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: In this Roguelite RPG you have to survive a fractured dark fantasy realm. Brave cursed forests, drowned cities, and searing deserts. Scavenge resources, obtain powerful gear, rebuild your sanctuary, and conquer monstrous horrors. Uncover ancient secrets before the abyss claims everything.
